anubarak.note: Beetle spam build, dive their backline
anubarak.why: 47.8% wr: fine into mages, outclassed otherwise

plan.early: Poke with Impale through the wave, keep Harden Carapace for their mage rotation, never burn Burrow Charge in; it is your only out
plan.mid: Cocoon at 10: Burrow Charge the healer, Cocoon them, Impale the peelers. Start every objective fight with your engage or don't start it
plan.fight: Burrow the backline mage, Cocoon the healer, then turn and Impale divers off your carry. No charge without follow-up in range
plan.late: Epicenter at 16 widens your engage, but sustained AAs melt you late. Carapace eats spell burst; disengage when it is down

anubarak.solo: Can offlane vs casters thanks to Harden Carapace spell shield, but AA bruisers like Leoric and Sonya run him out of lane

plan.early: Trade with Twin Blades then back off; Blade Dash through the wave to cycle Shield Overload. Don't spend Dash as pure damage
plan.mid: Suppression Pulse at 10: blind their AA core as fights start, then Phase Prism swap their squishiest into your team
plan.fight: Prism-swap the backline carry into your team, Dash out after. Engage when Shield Overload is up, disengage when it is down
plan.late: You win long brawls: Force of Will at 16 keeps shields rolling. Blinds and roots kill you; hold Dash to escape, not chase

artanis.solo: Solid solo: out-trades sustain bruisers with Twin Blades and shield cycling; blinds (Johanna, Li Li) and Leoric make his lane miserable

blaze.why: 52.5% wr: tanky waveclear, strong on nearly every map

plan.early: Hit BOTH Flame Streams on the enemy laner, drop Oil Spill on globes to zone, hold Jet Propulsion strictly for ganks
plan.mid: Bunker Drop at 10: drop it ON your team when their burst lands; everyone ports in, walks out with flamethrowers rolling
plan.fight: Ignite Oil Spill under their divers, body-block for your carry, save Jet to peel. Bunker beats Mosh and Apocalypse combos
plan.late: Juggernaut Plating at 16 makes you unkillable in oil, but percent damage still shreds you. Never fight with Bunker on CD

blaze.solo: Comfortable solo: double-soaks with long-range streams and bullies melee bruisers; Leoric and Malthael percent damage beat him

chen.why: 48.0% wr but 27% ban: brew sustain bullies melee, very strong lately

plan.early: Keg Smash into Breath of Fire, weave AAs to refill brew. Drink behind the wave and bait their interrupt before committing
plan.mid: Wandering Keg at 10: bowl their team off the objective or roll one tank into your side. Never keg enemies onto your own backline
plan.fight: Stagger their engage: Flying Kick the diver, Keg Smash slow, drink through the burst. Your job is soaking CDs, not chasing kills
plan.late: You win by attrition, but every stun cancels your brew. Bait CC first, drink after; Purifying Brew at 20 removes that weakness

chen.solo: Strong solo: out-sustains Sonya and Mal'Ganis style traders; Yrel and stun-heavy laners who cancel Fortifying Brew bully him

dva.why: 51.5% wr: two health bars, self-peel, objective stalling

plan.early: Boosters between two lanes to double-soak; de-meched, Big Shot the wave, hero hits refund Call Mech. Matrix their AA laner in trades
plan.mid: Bunny Hop at 10: wait for their frontline to commit, then hop the clump and keep 3+ perma-stunned on the objective
plan.fight: Defense Matrix the Tychus or Valla, Boosters to peel your healer, throw Self-Destruct into the choke as zone denial
plan.late: Losing mech to CC plus burst mid-fight is your death spiral: Matrix BEFORE stuns land, keep Self-Destruct charged for resets

dva.solo: Great solo: absurdly hard to kill and Boosters double-soak; Leoric out-trades pilot form and percent damage melts the mech

diablo.note: Flip combos near walls, feed souls first

plan.early: Stack souls fast: trade with Shadow Charge into Overpower under your own gate, Fire Stomp the wave. At 100 souls play fearless
plan.mid: Lightning Breath at 10: flip a target with Overpower first, then breathe while Unstoppable. Charge their mage on objectives
plan.fight: Charge a squishy into your team, or Overpower their diver back onto your carry as the peel. Aim Fire Stomps into the clump
plan.late: Hellgate at 20 flips fights alone, but at 0 souls you are paper. Never chain deaths; the 100-soul buff IS your tankiness

diablo.solo: Workable solo with Fire Stomp sustain, punishes immobile laners near walls; percent damage and Garrosh tosses ruin him

etc.note: Mosh threat wins fights, powerslide engage
etc.why: 48.6% wr: Mosh into a stacked team still swings games

plan.early: Play safe soak, heal with Guitar Solo, slide only through the wave with an exit. Powerslide is engage AND escape, never both
plan.mid: Mosh Pit at 10: slide-stun only when it does not risk your Mosh; Face Melt their engage, then Mosh the re-clump on objectives
plan.fight: Powerslide the backline, hold Mosh for a 3+ clump, count their interrupts first. Face Melt peels divers off your healer
plan.late: A landed late Mosh wins the game and a cancelled one loses it. Track every enemy stun and channel-breaker before you press R

etc.solo: Rarely solos; only offlane on huge maps with a Stage Dive build, otherwise keep him main tank

garrosh.note: Throw divers into your team, anti-dive king
garrosh.why: 53.6% wr + 39% ban: throw into your team is a free kill

plan.early: Trade under your tower: Groundbreaker pull, Wrecking Ball toss into tower shots, Bloodthirst back up. You are strongest at low HP
plan.mid: Decimate at 10: spam the slow on objectives and toss their bruiser into your team the second your mage has cooldowns
plan.fight: Toss the diver off your healer, or flip their carry into your team. Armor Up means you tank BETTER while low; don't panic out
plan.late: Late, every Wrecking Ball should trade a kill. Watch for Unstoppable and Iron Skin timers; toss the target who cannot answer

garrosh.solo: Fine solo: nearly ungankable at low HP under tower; loses pure sustain wars to Mal'Ganis and percent-damage laners

johanna.why: 52.3% wr + 55% ban, most banned hero: safe, blind-pickable, unkillable

plan.early: Punish the melee laner on CD, Shield Glare their AA windows, Iron Skin AFTER their stun commits. Condemn drags the wave for clears
plan.mid: Blessed Shield at 10: open fights by stunning two, or bank it to interrupt Mosh Pit and Ring of Frost on objectives
plan.fight: Walk at their carry, Condemn pull into Punish, keep the AA hero Glared all fight. Iron Skin their engage; you cannot be peeled
plan.late: Your risk is tanking with no threat: hit multi-hero Glares for Holy Renewal at 16 and hold Iron Skin to eat their wombo

johanna.solo: Safe solo into anything and blunts AA bruisers with Glare; low kill threat means Dehaka or Leoric happily out-soak her

malganis.why: 49.6% wr: sleep + sustain, fell off after nerfs

plan.early: Weave AAs between Fel Claws swipes, the third swipe stuns for a free trade. Necrotic Embrace shrugs poke; sleep ganks with Night Rush
plan.mid: Carrion Swarm at 10: stun with the third Fel Claws swipe, then swarm through 3+ heroes to heal back to full mid-fight
plan.fight: Night Rush their healer to sleep, chain Fel Claws stuns onto the carry. Every extra hero you hit is extra healing; fight in the pile
plan.late: Plague Bats at 16 turns swarm into a fight-winner; hard CC during it is your death. Bait stuns, then commit and outlast them

malganis.solo: Elite solo sustain: out-heals nearly every bruiser trade; ranged offlaners and healing reduction (Ana) neuter him

muradin.why: 47.8% wr on a huge sample, but the safest tank floor in the game

plan.early: Hold Storm Bolt until Thunder Clap's slow guarantees it, soak and let Second Wind top you off, Dwarf Toss over terrain resets ganks
plan.mid: Avatar at 10: pop it entering the objective fight and eat their CC as the sponge; if it is down, do not start fights
plan.fight: Peel first: Thunder Clap the divers, Storm Bolt the kill target when your team commits, Dwarf Toss out last
plan.late: Avatar plus Second Wind is near-immortal vs spell comps, but Tychus-style percent damage ignores it. Never Toss INTO five

muradin.solo: Classic safe solo: escapes any gank with Dwarf Toss and heals it off; sustain traders like Mal'Ganis slowly win the lane

stitches.note: One hook wins the fight, play brush
stitches.why: 47.2% wr: hook value is real, everything else is slow

plan.early: Hook only clean lanes, it stops on minions. Slam clears and dismounts roamers; Devour the bruiser to out-sustain trades
plan.mid: Gorge at 10: Hook the healer, walk them into your team, then Gorge whoever comes to save them. Hold Hook to break channels
plan.fight: One button wins it: Hook their carry into five allies. Follow with Gorge on the second target, Slam slow to peel after
plan.late: Master Hooker at 20 makes picks constant: hook from fog, never from plain sight. A missed hook means playing the fight 4v5

stitches.solo: Decent solo: Devour keeps him topped forever; percent damage (Malthael, Tychus flex) and slippery laners like Dehaka beat him

tyrael.why: 56.2% wr on a real sample: sanctification answers every engage

plan.early: Poke with El'druin's Might and teleport back out, Smite the wave edge for move speed rotations, Righteousness BEFORE damage lands
plan.mid: Judgment at 10 to dive carries after escapes are down; take Sanctification instead when they run Mosh or KTZ wombo
plan.fight: El'druin in, Righteousness your diver, Smite speed the chase. Even dying works: your death bomb zones their backline
plan.late: You enable the carry, not yourself: hold Sanctification for their R combo. Sancting nothing is how late fights get lost

tyrael.solo: Flex solo: very safe with El'druin escapes but low kill pressure; Arthas and Blaze out-trade him all lane

chogall.note: Two heads one body, only with a duo partner

plan.early: Two players, one body: soak the safest lane, Cho lands close-range Rune Bombs so Gall detonates Runic Blast on cooldown
plan.mid: Hammer of Twilight plus Twisting Nether at 10: Surging Fist in, Hammer stun, Nether the clump; Gall never stops Shadowflame
plan.fight: You ARE the frontline: Fist their carry, Hammer the peeler, Gall dumps Shadowflame and Dread Orb nonstop. Leave at 50%, not 20%
plan.late: You feed double XP when you die: never get caught solo. C'Thun's Gift and Twilight Frenzy at 20 win any grouped fight

dehaka.why: 50.7% wr + 14% ban: global bruiser, drags win games

plan.early: Soak two lanes with Brushstalker, eat essence globs, and save the Essence Collection burst heal for when a gank actually lands.
plan.mid: Isolation at 10: silence-blind their carry, then Drag them into your team. Brushstalker to the objective the second it spawns.
plan.fight: Ambush from a bush, weave an auto first, then Drag the backliner over the wall into your team. Hold essence until they burn burst.
plan.late: Late you win on cross-map Brushstalker picks; Isolation plus Drag makes every fight 4v5. Kite comps like Valla are your death.

dehaka.solo: Safe, sustainy solo laner who bullies immobile bruisers and never misses soak; ranged kite laners and blind comps outlast him.

deathwing.why: 52.2% wr: unstoppable stat monster, punishes cc-light comps

plan.early: Land at full armor, clear waves in World Breaker from range, and lift out before the plates melt. Never fight below half armor.
plan.mid: Cataclysm the objective start: the burn zone forces them off the point. Drop Destroyer form on their backline when your team commits.
plan.fight: You are permanently unstoppable: land on the clump, Onslaught stun the carry, Incinerate, then Dragonflight out before you go red.
plan.late: Late the risk is percent damage, Tychus and Giant Killer shred plates. Leave at half armor, reset in the sky, re-drop for round two.

deathwing.solo: Fine solo pick: World Breaker poke bullies melee bruisers who cannot trade back; Malthael and percent-damage laners send him home.

gazlowe.note: Zone bully, take camps on cooldown
gazlowe.why: 55.2% wr: turret zone control bullies most solo laners

plan.early: Hide Rock-It Turrets in bushes by the wave, Xplodium under it, collect scrap. You outclear everyone, so shove and take early camps.
plan.mid: Grav-O-Bomb at 10: hold it until they clump on the objective, pull them into Xplodium's stun, then turrets and Deth Lazor eat the pile.
plan.fight: Set turrets BEFORE the fight and make them come to your nest. Grav-O into Xplodium is the wombo; never open with the bomb alone.
plan.late: Late you win zone control: pre-stack turret nests on the point. Long-range poke like Chromie dismantles the nest before anyone enters.

gazlowe.solo: Sturdy solo laner on his turret nest; melee who must step into it lose, but ranged laners like Lunara poke him off his scrap for free.

plan.early: Charge the bruiser through the minion line, stack Valor with W and E, consume with AAs. Flash of Anger at 7 wins every trade
plan.mid: Wrath of the Angiris at 10: lift the carry and drop them inside your team, but only when follow-up CC is ready to land
plan.fight: Lay Solarion's Fire, Charge-pin their carry along it, Molten Armor the marked target. Vs dive, save Charge to peel your healer
plan.late: Late Wraths must hit the carry with your team set to catch; you are airborne and useless for 2s, so time it as the opener

imperius.solo: Top-tier solo bully: beats Sonya, Artanis, and The Butcher head-on; ranged kiters and Sgt. Hammer deny his Charge

leoric.note: Percent-damage tank shredder, never truly dies

plan.early: Skeletal Swing slow first so the full Drain Hope channel sticks; even dead you keep soaking as Undying, so never leave lane XP
plan.mid: Entomb at 10: box the healer against a wall on the objective, Drain Hope inside while your team collapses on them
plan.fight: March at the biggest health bar, Drain their tank's percent HP, Wraith Walk through bodies to reach the healer. Die AFTER it's won
plan.late: Buried Alive at 20 removes their carry for 4s: open fights with it. Mobile heroes walk out of Entomb; trap against walls only

leoric.solo: Premier solo soaker: even his corpse soaks XP; Dehaka out-rotates him and Samuro or Tracer dodge everything he throws

malthael.note: Melts tanks, useless into ranged kite
malthael.why: 55.4% wr: percent damage shreds tanks and bruisers

plan.early: One Death Shroud marks the whole wave and Soul Rip heals it back. Trade into any melee freely, your percent damage always wins.
plan.mid: Last Rites at 10: mark, shave them under the execute line, cash it. Do not sit on it, a guaranteed kill is worth the cooldown.
plan.fight: Live on their frontline: keep two or three marked, Soul Rip on cooldown, Wraith Strike through the tank to tag the backline when safe.
plan.late: Late you melt 20-stack tanks and Last Rites the biggest one at 25 percent. Blinds and kiting blank you, pick your moment to stick.

malthael.solo: Solid solo vs tanky bruisers he shreds with marks; Fenix and ranged offlaners kite him and Lunara's poison outtrades Soul Rip.

ragnaros.why: 49.2% wr: lava wave wins push maps

plan.early: Offlane: Empower Sulfuras clears the wave and heals in one swing, Living Meteor the camp. Trade around trait, back off without it.
plan.mid: Lava Wave at 10: send it down the opposite lane the moment the objective starts. It erases the wave and forces a defender home.
plan.fight: Second-line bruiser: let your tank open, then Empower cleave their front and Blast Wave out. Never lead, you have no escape when focused.
plan.late: Late, Molten Core turns a fort defense into a won fight; Sulfuras Smash the CC'd clump. Displacement like Garrosh ruins your trait.

ragnaros.solo: Premier solo laner: Empower sustain beats most bruisers and he never misses soak; Chen and Garrosh displacement give him fits.

rexxar.note: Solo lane + camps, Misha peels dive
rexxar.why: 57.9% wr but thin sample: misha controls the solo lane

plan.early: Send Misha into the wave while you auto from range; park her in the gank bush. You never miss soak and duo camps early with her.
plan.mid: Unleash the Boars at 10: fire it as they rotate to the objective to reveal and slow all five, then collapse with the Misha stun.
plan.fight: Misha, Charge! the diver off your healer and body-block skillshots with her; you stay on the edge with autos and Spirit Swoop slows.
plan.late: Late you split the map: Misha holds a lane or point alone while you fight. Mobile assassins who ignore Misha and jump you are the risk.

rexxar.solo: Elite solo laner: Misha tanks while Rexxar soaks for free, bullying Azmodan and Xul; hard divers like Illidan kill him through her.

sonya.why: 48.3% wr: classic solo laner, dives well

plan.early: Offlane: Whirlwind through the full wave to heal, Ancient Spear whoever tries to leave. Solo your camp at 5, she takes it fastest.
plan.mid: Wrath of the Berserker at 10: pop it, Spear in, keep swinging so Fury extends it. Use it to shrug slows and stuns, not as a finisher.
plan.fight: Spear their backline only with follow-up; otherwise Whirlwind the frontline and be unkillable. Wrath halves stun and root duration.
plan.late: Late you out-duel anyone and solo bosses. Silences and Tychus melt you mid-Whirlwind, so count their CC before you commit the Spear.

sonya.solo: Top-tier solo bruiser: Whirlwind sustain wins almost every melee matchup; Leoric drains her and blind or kite lanes shut her down.

thrall.why: 51.4% wr on a big sample: reliable sustain bruiser

plan.early: Feral Spirit the wave then poke with Chain Lightning; Frostwolf Resilience heals every trade. The wolf root starts every gank.
plan.mid: Sundering at 10: split their team on the objective or wall the carry off from the healer, then root and Windfury the stranded half.
plan.fight: Second-wave assassin: let the tank engage, then Windfury onto the CC'd target and wolf-root the peel. Never lead the charge yourself.
plan.late: Late a good Sundering wins the fight alone; keep trait stacks banked before you engage. Kite comps that deny his autos starve him.

thrall.solo: Can offlane vs melee, trait sustain and the wolf root punish hard, but self-sustain bruisers like Johanna and Arthas outlast him.

varian.note: Flex pick: taunt tank or twin blades carry
varian.why: 50.9% wr: flexible tank or damage, jack of all trades

plan.early: Trade with Lion's Fang and Parry the big auto; your spike is level 4 when the heroic comes online. Shove, then join the first gank.
plan.mid: Pick at 4: Taunt if you must tank, Twin Blades to carry, Smash for burst. On objectives open by Charge-Taunting their key damage.
plan.fight: Charge in, Taunt the carry your team is already hitting, Parry the counter-swing. Taunt also interrupts channels, save it for those.
plan.late: Late Taunt Varian peels and interrupts; Twin Blades must stay on safe targets. You are the CC magnet, so track Parry charges.

varian.solo: Decent solo laner after 4: Twin Blades sustain bullies melee and Parry blanks Butcher; ranged offlaners kite him out before then.

xul.why: 47.6% wr: push machine, weak in fights

plan.early: You are the wave: clear, mount, rotate, clear again while skeletons shove. Bone Armor makes ganks cheap. Never stop soaking.
plan.mid: Skeletal Mages at 10: wall the objective choke so their team enters slowed or gives the point up. Cast it early, not as a save.
plan.fight: Bone Prison their diver, Cursed Strikes to halve every auto-attacker's speed, mages across the choke. You zone, you do not assassinate.
plan.late: Late the push wins: every dead hero means a skeleton lane hitting core. Getting picked first is the risk, use Bone Armor early.

xul.solo: Classic solo laner: out-pushes everyone and Cursed Strikes ruins melee auto-attackers; Johanna's blind and ranged poke keep him passive.

yrel.note: Late-game bully, save allies with E
yrel.why: 56.0% wr this patch (volatile): unkillable with a healer

plan.early: Offlane: charge Vindication on the wave to heal, keep Divine Purpose banked for an instant Righteous Hammer when they jump you.
plan.mid: Sacred Ground at 10: drop it ON the point and dare them to walk in. You cannot be moved off it, so hold until they truly commit.
plan.fight: Front-arc bully: Hammer the diver off your healer, Avenging Wrath stun the clump, charge casts from behind your tank's body.
plan.late: Late she is near unkillable on Sacred Ground; take Ardent Defender into burst. Percent damage and Stukov's silence cancel her charges.

yrel.solo: A-tier solo bruiser: outsustains melee and punishes dives with Divine Purpose stuns; Malthael and ranged percent pressure beat her.

thebutcher.note: Feed him meat, one lamb equals one kill
thebutcher.why: 51.5% wr: snowballs off stacks, punishes squishy comps

plan.early: Meat first, kills second: soak and last-hit for Fresh Meat and do not die, deaths cost stacks. Hit 200 before you play hero.
plan.mid: Lamb to the Slaughter at 10: chain it onto Ruthless Onslaught, Brand the target, they die tethered. Flank objectives, never walk in front.
plan.fight: One job: Onslaught the marked squishy with Brand up and kill them inside the Lamb. Brand is your only sustain, never waste it as damage.
plan.late: Late with 200 meat you one-combo squishies; blinds and body-block peel blank you. A CC'd Butcher is a dead Butcher, count their stuns.

thebutcher.solo: Can offlane for stacks against passive laners, but real bruisers like Johanna or Yrel starve him; start ganking once meat is rolling.

alexstrasza.note: Big fight healing in dragon form

plan.early: Poke with Flame Buffet, drop Abundance behind minions for real trades; Gift of Life costs your own HP, never cast it below half.
plan.mid: Take Life-Binder at 10 for the double heal; open objective fights in Dragonqueen form when they commit and can't disengage.
plan.fight: Stand second line, pre-place Abundance where your team will actually fight, and save Dragonqueen to flip their hard engage.
plan.late: Late, Verdant Flourish keeps you topped for cheap Gift of Life; you lose to anti-heal and dive, never start a fight under 60% HP.

anduin.note: Pull saves divers, huge clutch ult
anduin.why: 49.0% wr + 23% ban: pull saves, solid all-rounder

plan.early: Poke with Divine Star through the wave for double value; cancel Flash Heal channels you don't need to save mana and cooldown.
plan.mid: Lightbomb at 10; hold it for their dive landing on your backline, one two-man stun wins most objective fights.
plan.fight: Keep Leap of Faith for the hooked or gorged ally, pull the instant CC lands, then Chastise the diver off yourself.
plan.late: Late your Lightwell build out-sustains poke, but you have no escape; stay in Chastise range of your tank and never show side lane.

auriel.note: Needs a damage battery, res wins fights
auriel.why: 52.7% wr: free healing scales with your damage dealers

plan.early: Bestow Hope on your highest-damage laner and bank energy; Detainment Strike into a wall is your kill setup, don't poke with it.
plan.mid: Crystal Aegis at 10; Aegis the ally mid-combo, not after it lands, and never start an objective without a full energy bar.
plan.fight: Your healing IS your team's damage: call fights on, keep Ray of Heaven hitting two allies, stun-peel divers into walls with Q.
plan.late: Late, empty energy means zero healing; if your carry dies, disengage. Aegis the Pyroblast target and reset the fight on your terms.

brightwing.why: 46.8% picked-wr BUT 40% ban rate: feared global healer, wins maps not fights

plan.early: Soak your lane and poke with center-hit Arcane Flare; Soothing Mist heals passively, so save Polymorph for the gank, not the trade.
plan.mid: Blink Heal at 10; teleport to the objective the moment it spawns, your global trait is worth a full extra hero on the map.
plan.fight: Sit mid-team, Polymorph the diver the second they commit to your backline, and spend Blink Heal charges early, they recharge.
plan.late: Late, keep teleporting to soak between fights; BW wins by being a level up and by Poly denying their carry, not by raw healing.

deckard.note: Sleep + gem root chains, elite CC healer
deckard.why: 47.4% wr: cc toolkit is real but healing output lags

plan.early: Toss Healing Potions behind your laner BEFORE the trade; Horadric Cube poke plus potions wins most sustain lanes outright.
plan.mid: Stay Awhile and Listen most games; cast the sleep from fog or behind your frontline so it can't be dodged, then collapse on it.
plan.fight: Land Scroll of Sealing on two-plus heroes, follow with Cube slow, and litter potions along the path your team retreats through.
plan.late: Late, Morenados zone whole fights; your death risk is mobile divers, hug your team and pre-pot before the poke ever lands.

plan.early: Trade with Deadly Reach and trait procs, Radiant Dash in and out; with Transcendence every third punch heals, so keep swinging.
plan.mid: Divine Palm vs burst comps, Seven-Sided Strike vs tanks; at objectives only dash their backline once key stuns are down.
plan.fight: Play hybrid: punch the frontliner to fuel Transcendence heals, keep one Dash charge to exit, Palm the ally about to get bursted.
plan.late: Late, SSS melts high-HP targets; blinds and roots ruin you, track Johanna's Blind and never burn both Dash charges going in.

kharazim.solo: Can flex offlane with the Iron Fists damage build, but you give up a real healer; niche pick, not his best seat.

lili.note: Blinds shut down auto-attackers, easy to play
lili.why: 52.2% wr: blinds shut down auto-attack comps, hard to punish

plan.early: Healing Brew is free, heal on cooldown; angle Cloud Serpent onto whoever trades and hover danger's edge to keep Fast Feet rolling.
plan.mid: Jug of 1,000 Cups at 10; start it EARLY in the fight before anyone is bursted, and cancel instantly to move if you get dived.
plan.fight: Blinding Wind the Illidan or Raynor the moment they commit; your job is uptime: brew every 3s, Serpent the frontline, keep moving.
plan.late: Late, Jug of 1,000,000 Cups out-sustains anything if you live; you lose to burst, hug your tank and bait the dive before jugging.

lucio.note: Speed wins fights, boop peels engage
lucio.why: 43.8% wr, bottom three in the game right now

plan.early: Crossfade Speed for rotations, Healing for trades; Wall Ride to soak two lanes and Soundwave to interrupt their engage attempts.
plan.mid: High Five at 10 on most maps; hit Amp It Up on speed as your team engages so everyone arrives before their stuns come back up.
plan.fight: Stay stacked, your aura only hits nearby allies; Amp healing right after their burst window, Soundwave the diver off your mage.
plan.late: Late, three-man Amped speed engages win games; CC is your death, keep Wall Riding mid-fight so you're never a stationary target.

malfurion.note: Root setups + silence ult, always safe
malfurion.why: 46.8% wr, worst healer bracket this patch

plan.early: Keep Regrowth rolling on your laner, Moonfire only to refresh it and check bushes; Innervate your mage's mana between waves.
plan.mid: Tranquility at 10 most comps; channel as damage STARTS, not at 20% HP, and root divers as they land so your team can turn.
plan.fight: Pre-Regrowth two targets before the engage, land Entangling Roots on already-CC'd enemies, save Tranq for their heroic burst.
plan.late: Late, Twilight Dream at 20 silences entire fights; your risk is burst dive, stand deep with roots between you and their melee.

rehgar.why: 51.5% wr: ancestral denies picks, bloodlust wins brawls

plan.early: Ghost Wolf between lane and camps, empowered bites clear waves; Earthbind on trades, Chain Heal when it bounces to two-plus.
plan.mid: Ancestral Healing at 10; cast it EARLY on the focus target, a half-second late is a death. Take camps with wolf speed between waves.
plan.fight: Ride your melee: Lightning Shield the Sonya or Illidan, Earthbind under the brawl, bank Ancestral for whoever they commit on.
plan.late: Late, Farseer's Blessing Ancestral wins extended fights; Ana's grenade blanks it, so bait the anti-heal before you commit the heal.

stukov.why: 44.7% wr: silence arm is good, everything else lags

plan.early: Spread Healing Pathogen so it jumps to allies through the wave; poke with Weighted Pustule and pop Bio-Kill Switch for burst value.
plan.mid: Flailing Swipe vs melee balls, Lurking Arm otherwise; at objectives park the Arm's silence on the choke they must walk through.
plan.fight: Pathogen the frontline pre-fight, hold Bio-Kill Switch until two-plus pathogens tick, Massive Shove the diver off your backline.
plan.late: Late, Universal Carrier keeps pathogens on everyone; you have no cleanse, so vs heavy CC stay behind the Arm and shove their engage.

tyrande.note: Healer that deletes people with a mark
tyrande.why: 52.1% wr: healer that helps delete people

plan.early: Trade with Light of Elune plus autos, set up ganks with Lunar Flare stuns, and fire Sentinel cross-map for free vision on rotation.
plan.mid: Shadowstalk vs ambush comps, Starfall vs sustain healers; Hunter's Mark the objective boss, the vulnerability melts it fast.
plan.fight: You heal by attacking: keep autos flowing, Flare the diver on your carry, Mark the target your team is actually focusing.
plan.late: Late, Celestial Attunement cleanses their lockdown; you die fast, play max range and hold Flare for self-peel, not for damage.

uther.note: Armor on everything, stun secures kills
uther.why: 55.5% wr: armor + stuns, best clutch healer right now

plan.early: Trade around Holy Radiance hitting wave plus laner; your mana dies fast, so no reflex Holy Lights, save them for real burst.
plan.mid: Divine Shield at 10; bubble your aggro melee as they engage, and heal BEFORE damage lands, every heal grants Devotion armor.
plan.fight: Hold Divine Shield for their engage target, stun-secure kills with Hammer of Justice, use Benediction resets for double heals.
plan.late: Late, Redemption at 20 means your death isn't a fight loss, keep frontlining; the real risk is mana, tap the well every push.

whitemane.why: 57.4% wr: infinite mana healing through damage

plan.early: Zeal your laner FIRST, then poke with Searing Lash, the damage converts to healing; watch Desperation stacks or you go OOM.
plan.mid: Scarlet Aegis at 10 most games; open objective fights with Aegis to mass-apply Zeal, hold Inquisition to cancel their engage.
plan.fight: Keep Zeal on two-plus allies and never stop casting Smite and Lash; Inquisition the diver, but drop it if Zeal targets get low.
plan.late: Late your damage-healing out-scales everyone, but one displacement kills you; play behind terrain vs Garrosh, pre-Zeal every dive.

ana.note: Sleep dart flips fights, skillshot healer
ana.why: 51.4% wr: high skill, sleep dart flips fights

plan.early: Hit every Healing Dart, each miss is lost sustain; keep Sleep Dart for defense only and dart bushes before anyone facechecks.
plan.mid: Nano Boost at 10; cast it on your mage AS the fight starts, not mid-fight, so the 8s window covers their full rotation.
plan.fight: Max range behind your tank, land anti-heal Biotic Grenade on their engage target, Sleep Dart the diver that jumps you.
plan.late: Late you die to any dive: hug terrain, hold Sleep for Genji or Zeratul, and grenade their healer right before your team commits.

abathur.note: Body soaks a lane, hat the carry
abathur.why: 47.3% wr BUT 20% ban: in capable hands far above his stats

plan.early: Body-soak the safest lane behind gates, hat the winning trade elsewhere; seed Toxic Nests in bushes and camp entrances for vision.
plan.mid: Ultimate Evolution at 10; clone your Greymane or Illidan as the objective fight starts, then swap the body to soak the empty lane.
plan.fight: Fight as the hat: Symbiote your engager, spam Spike Burst, shield Carapace on their burst window; your body keeps soaking elsewhere.
plan.late: Late, locusts plus Nests win on map pressure; track enemy globals, a found Abathur body is a free kill and a lost keep, move often.

abathur.solo: Not a laner but the team's extra soaker; the body sits safe in a side lane while the hat plays the map.

medivh.note: Portals enable insane engages, shields deny burst
medivh.why: 45.2% wr: pro-play hero, solo queue trap

plan.early: Raven Form to scout and soak two lanes; gank with Portal for your laners and bank Force of Will for the counter-gank, it wins 2v2s.
plan.mid: Ley Line Seal at 10; seal half their team while yours bursts the other half, or take Poly Bomb into stacked melee comps.
plan.fight: Force of Will the engage target the moment CC lands, Portal your backline out of dive, weave Arcane Rifts through the fight.
plan.late: Late, a whiffed Ley Line loses the game, cast it on CC'd targets only; Medivh value is damage your team never took, track shields.

plan.early: Waveclear with Psionic Storm and keep Resonance Beam stacked by tagging minions; channel Shock Ray from fog so it can't be dodged.
plan.mid: Archon at 10; pop it only after their stuns are burned and melt the frontline with splash, or Black Hole clumped teams.
plan.fight: Sit second line, Storm the brawl, Shock Ray finishers on runners; Dimensional Shift is your only out, never waste it to poke.
plan.late: Late, Archon timing decides fights; you're paper outside it, so track the enemy dive and hold Dimensional Shift for their opener.

zarya.note: Shields eat burst combos, grav wombo

plan.early: Lane with a partner: eat poke with Personal Barrier for free Energy, shield your ally right before trades, and grenade at high Energy.
plan.mid: Expulsion Zone at 10: drop it on the choke as they engage to cut their team in half, then unload the beam at 100 Energy.
plan.fight: Time Shield Ally onto the dive target as burst lands: their engage becomes your Energy, then melt whoever Expulsion displaced.
plan.late: Late you let your carry face-tank: keep both barriers rotating; the risk is Energy starving when they refuse to hit shields, force it.

ltmorales.why: 48.7% wr: single-target lock-on, dies to dive

plan.early: Beam the laner taking hits and let Caduceus Reactor regen you; hold Displacement Grenade for their gap-closer, it cancels engages.
plan.mid: Stim Drone at 10 on your Raynor or Valla at objectives; Medivac only with an organized five. Enter fights above half energy.
plan.fight: Tunnel the focus target with Healing Beam, Safeguard the burst, grenade divers off you; sync your steps so the beam never breaks.
plan.late: Late, Stim on your hypercarry wins fights outright; energy is finite, don't beam chip damage, and never facecheck, you feed picks.

plan.early: Win the solo lane to stack Sadism: Telekinesis them into Discord Strike's silence, and do not die, deaths bleed your stacks.
plan.mid: Counter-Strike at 10: bait their stun or burst, flip it back for the kill window, then combo Telekinesis into Discord Strike.
plan.fight: Go second: let tanks trade first, then Telekinesis their healer into your team, Discord silences the save, self-cast E to exit.
plan.late: At high Sadism you one-shot squishies; every late death costs stacks, so flank, kill isolated targets, and never coin-flip a fight.

alarak.solo: Premier solo laner: the silence wins trades, Lightning Surge clears while poking, and one kill snowballs Sadism; just respect ganks.

plan.early: Stack Globe of Annihilation on full waves, ping so team leaves you the wave; send Demon Lieutenant to empty lanes on cooldown.
plan.mid: At 10 take Demonic Invasion: drop it on a fort while your team stalls the objective, trading siege for their attention.
plan.fight: Open with max-range Globe on clumps, channel All Shall Burn only behind your front; cancel it the second a stun threatens.
plan.late: Late you win via a 200+ stack Globe and constant three-lane push; you lose if stunned mid-channel, so track their CC.

azmodan.solo: Strong solo laner: wins the sustained wave war while stacking Globe, but hard dive punishes his total lack of escape.

plan.early: Fend the wave, keep moving so Avoidance armor stays up, and throw Lightning Fury through gates to stack Thunderstroke.
plan.mid: At 10 take Ball Lightning: bounce it between two stunned targets at objectives, then Fend through the leftovers.
plan.fight: Your job is deleting their auto-attackers: Blinding Light the Valla or Raynor, then Fend blinded targets for bonus damage.
plan.late: Late, Infinite Lightning bounces win extended fights; stay stutter-stepping, standing still drops Avoidance and you melt.

cassia.solo: Can offlane into auto-attack bruisers thanks to Avoidance and Blind, but loses to mages and heavy CC; a niche counterpick.

chromie.note: Longest range in the game, punish immobile comps
chromie.why: 50.9% wr: long-range poke, punishes immobile comps

plan.early: Poke Sand Blast on cooldown from max range and finish Timewalker's Pursuit; you outrange everyone, never take return fire.
plan.mid: At her early 10 take Slowing Sands: drop it on the objective choke and Dragon's Breath anyone who sits in the slow.
plan.fight: Sit two screens back, spam Sand Blast into their frontline, and save Time Trap for the Zeratul or Tracer coming for you.
plan.late: Late you outrange keeps and win every poke war, but one dive kills you; never move without a Time Trap planted behind you.

falstad.why: 51.8% wr + 29% ban: global value on every big map

plan.early: Trade with Hammerang plus autos, keep Barrel Roll pocketed, and use Flight to double-soak the moment your wave is safe.
plan.mid: At 10 take Mighty Gust: fly cross-map to arrive first at objectives, then Gust their team off the point or into yours.
plan.fight: Stutter-step their frontline, hook Lightning Rod on whoever stays in range, and hold Gust to cancel a Mosh or peel divers.
plan.late: Late, Flight lets you soak and still make every fight; dying to stealth ganks mid-rotation is how you throw it.

falstad.solo: Not a true solo laner, but Flight covers the solo lane in a pinch and punishes offlaners who overextend without vision.

fenix.note: Shield resets, shreds tanks at range

plan.early: Swap weapons smartly: Repeater Cannon for trades, Phase Bomb for wave; poke Plasma Cutter plus autos while shields eat free.
plan.mid: At 10 take Purification Salvo: tag the two squishiest heroes at objectives, then Repeater Cannon them as the salvo lands.
plan.fight: Max-range stutter-step with Repeater Cannon, Plasma Cutter their retreat path, and Warp out the moment your shield breaks.
plan.late: Late, Offensive Cadence third shots win DPS races; Warp's delay is your risk, start it before they land on you, not after.

fenix.solo: Can hold a solo lane briefly on shields and waveclear, but zero sustain means he bleeds health; better in a duo lane.

gall.note: Other half of Cho, duo only

plan.early: You are the damage half: Shadowflame every wave Cho walks into, bounce Dread Orb behind minions for poke. Farm to 13, do not force.
plan.mid: Twisting Nether at 10: call it when Cho is deep and they clump, the slow plus detonation zones the whole objective by itself.
plan.fight: Your job is uptime: Shadowflame on cooldown, catch the Dread Orb bounce-back, and call targets. You steer the damage, Cho steers the feet.
plan.late: Late, two heads scale hardest in the game and 2v5 fights at 16 plus. Cocoon or Containment Disc deletes both of you, track Maiev.

genji.why: 48.3% wr: needs coordination solo queue rarely gives

plan.early: Poke with Shuriken fans, tax the wave, and keep Swift Strike as your exit; dying early on Genji is the only way to lose the lane.
plan.mid: X-Strike at 10: land it on a CC'd target after your tank's stun and Swift Strike through so both cross-slashes connect.
plan.fight: Hunt the lowest target: a Swift Strike kill resets the dash, Deflect their answer on the way in, Cyber Agility over the wall out.
plan.late: Late your resets snowball cleanups; the risks are mana and CC, so keep 25% mana, never dive without Deflect, exit before the stun.

greymane.note: Highest sustained damage in the game

plan.early: Bounce Gilnean Cocktail off the wave so the cone burns their hero, stay Human at range, and only go Worgen once their CC is down.
plan.mid: Cursed Bullet at 10: fire it into the tank or a fat healer right after your team engages, then Darkflight in and finish in Worgen.
plan.fight: Poke in Human until someone hits half, then all-in: Razor Swipe through them, Worgen autos, and Swipe back out when peel arrives.
plan.late: Late you execute anyone below half: wait out the healer's cooldowns before the all-in; overstaying in Worgen into CC kills you.

plan.early: Life Tap freely then Fel Flame the wave; you never leave lane for mana, just don't Tap below half with their ganker missing.
plan.mid: At 10 take Horrify: at objectives fear their frontline off your carries, or flip a dive the second they jump your backline.
plan.fight: Corruption the clump, Drain Life whoever your tank roots, and keep Healthstone for the burst window right after a Life Tap.
plan.late: Late, Haunt plus Darkness Within makes you a raid boss; mobile assassins are the loss condition, hug peel and pre-aim Horrify.

hanzo.note: Poke them out before the fight starts
hanzo.why: 50.8% wr: poke + waveclear, up this patch

plan.early: Storm Bow pokes at max range for Target Practice stacks; Sonic Arrow every bush before you step up, never facecheck.
plan.mid: At 10 take Dragon's Arrow: fire from mid range so the stun lands, then full Storm Bow charge plus Scatter on the stunned target.
plan.fight: Live at max bow range, ricochet Scatter Arrow off walls into melee, and keep Natural Agility strictly as your escape.
plan.late: Late, Bullseye stuns turn picks into won fights; divers are your risk, hop terrain early, not after they land on you.

illidan.note: Needs enablers and a blind-free enemy comp
illidan.why: 57.3% wr two patches running: sustain meta suits him, feed him a healer

plan.early: Auto everything: Betrayer's Thirst heals you and cuts cooldowns; take camps early, Dive behind for trades, Sweep out before CC.
plan.mid: The Hunt at 10: hold it to cross the map for a pick or to join the fight your team starts; open on the healer, never the tank.
plan.fight: Dive the backline with The Hunt, Evasion when autos focus you, Sweep through targets to dodge skillshots, kite back through your team.
plan.late: Late you live on tempo: split-push, force rotations, and only all-in when their stuns are down; one held Uther stun ends your run.

illidan.solo: Strong solo lane into auto-attackers thanks to Evasion; loses to blinds and sustained-CC bruisers, so ask for a swap versus Arthas.

jaina.note: Chill slows are soft CC everywhere

plan.early: One Blizzard clears the caster wave; poke Frostbolt into Ice Lance combos and keep Cone of Cold for anyone who jumps you.
plan.mid: At 10 take Water Elemental: open objective fights with Elemental plus Blizzard on the clump for chained Frostbite slows.
plan.fight: Hold Ring of Frost for their dive, chain Cone of Cold slows so melee never reach you, burst the rooted target with Ice Lance.
plan.late: Late your combo one-shots squishies, but you are the squishiest thing alive; play behind two bodies and pre-cast on chokes.

plan.early: Lob Frag Launcher at the front edge of their hitbox so grenades bounce in; trap the bush, keep Concussion Mine for escapes.
plan.mid: At 10 take RIP-Tire: drive it in from fog at objectives to split their team, then spam frags into the choke they retreat through.
plan.fight: Shell the clump from behind your tank, pre-place Steel Trap on the flank route, and mine divers off your healer, not for damage.
plan.late: Late you zone entire chokes and Total Mayhem trades even in death; mobile assassins are still your death sentence, hug peel.

kaelthas.note: Chain bomb wombo with any root
kaelthas.why: 45.5% wr: burst mages are down across the board

plan.early: Verdant Spheres Living Bomb one-shots the caster wave and feeds Mana Addict; Gravity Lapse anyone who walks at you.
plan.mid: At 10 take Phoenix: land it on the objective so it zones and sieges, and save Verdant Spheres for the follow-up Flamestrike.
plan.fight: Spread Living Bomb into their clump, empowered Flamestrike the stunned target; hold Lapse for the diver, it is your only peel.
plan.late: Late an empowered bomb chain wipes teams; you die in one rotation though, so cast from fog and never lead the walk-up.

kelthuzad.why: 50.8% wr: chain combo one-shots, high skill

plan.early: Every Chains hit on a hero builds Master of the Cold Dark; fish combos in lane, finishing the quest early is your whole game.
plan.mid: At 10 take Frost Blast: Chains a target, root the clump, then land the full combo and Death and Decay on the frozen pile.
plan.fight: One combo decides it: Chains the frontliner to a wall, Frost Nova the pair, then recast Chains through Glacial Spike.
plan.late: Late with quest done you one-combo squishies; you have zero escapes, so combo from range and keep a body between you and dives.

kerrigan.why: 57.2% wr: combo one-shots squishies, snowballs hard

plan.early: Stack your level 1 Ravage quest on minions; when they step up, Primal Grasp into Impaling Blades. Assimilation shields win the trade.
plan.mid: Summon Ultralisk at 10: send it as engage or as a peel wall, then run the Grasp into Blades into Ravage combo while it tanks.
plan.fight: You are the pick: Grasp their squishy into the Blades stun and let the team follow. Combo, then let Assimilation shields eat the poke.
plan.late: Late the full combo one-shots; whiffing Grasp is the risk since it is her whole engage. Hold it until their dodge cooldowns are down.

kerrigan.solo: Rarely solos: the combo needs kill follow-up and she starves alone; only offlane her into immobile melee as a cheese pick.

liming.why: 51.8% wr on a big sample: resets snowball teamfights

plan.early: Magic Missiles on cooldown, hero hits refund mana with Charged Blast; throw Arcane Orb only at max range where it hurts.
plan.mid: At 10 take Wave of Force into dive or channel comps; fish for one objective kill, the reset refreshes everything, re-engage.
plan.fight: Third line, max range: Orb the clump, Missiles the low target, Teleport aggressively ONLY when the reset kill is guaranteed.
plan.late: Late every reset chains another kill and Tal Rasha ramps; overchasing after one Teleport is how you hand the fight back.

lunara.why: 49.2% wr: poison pressure, hard to catch

plan.early: Poison autos then hop back and let Nature's Toxin tick; Noxious Blossom the wave, never burn Leaping Strike to engage.
plan.mid: At 10 take Thornwood Vine: weave the three-hit vines through objective fights to keep toxin rolling on their whole team.
plan.fight: Kite at max range, keep poison ticking on every enemy the healer must save, save Leaping Strike for the Butcher on you.
plan.late: Late your dot pressure breaks single-target healers; AoE-cleanse healers blank you, so spread toxin wider, not deeper.

lunara.solo: Real offlane option: outranges melee bruisers, poisons and skips away, but a gank with Leaping Strike down usually kills her.

mephisto.note: Skull spam then global execute ult

plan.early: Lightning Nova the wave then walk it onto their melee; every hero hit refunds cooldowns, so you win trades by circling.
plan.mid: At 10 take Durance of Hate: at objectives Shade in, Nova the clump, and throw Skull Missile as you snap back to safety.
plan.fight: Shade behind them, spin Lightning Nova through max targets, and aim Durance at slowed or rooted heroes so it cannot miss.
plan.late: Late, Nova with full CDR is a fight-long AoE; the snapback spot is your life, never cast Shade from a losing position.

nazeebo.why: 43.2% wr, second worst in the game

plan.early: Every minion killed by an ability stacks Voodoo Ritual; Spiders plus Blossom each wave, hit big stacks early or fall off.
plan.mid: At 10 take Gargantuan: drop it at objectives for the stomp slow, and trap their bruiser in Zombie Wall for your team.
plan.fight: Wall the diver off your healer or wall their tank in, Blossom plus Spiders inside it, and keep Ice Block for when they turn.
plan.late: Late, Vile Infection makes toxin lethal; if the quest is not done you are a minion, so soak waves relentlessly all game.

nazeebo.solo: Passable solo laner on big maps: safe ranged clear while stacking Ritual, but loses hard to dive bruisers before Ice Block.

plan.early: Gank, don't lane: Pinning Shot into Snipe from cloak on overextended squishies; Holo Decoy baits abilities before you commit.
plan.mid: At 10 take Precision Strike: snipe objective fights from fog, and use it globally to clear far catapult waves between fights.
plan.fight: You are a finisher, not an opener: wait for CC, Pinning Shot into Snipe on the 60 percent target, recloak, reposition, repeat.
plan.late: Late, Rewind doubles your burst combo; if their tank buys reveal or Zarya bubbles your target, swap marks fast or go siege.

plan.early: Chomp the wave for safe clear, poke Shadow Waltz from range, and bank Chaos stacks; the dash is your escape, not damage.
plan.mid: At 10 take Eternal Feast: land it on two-plus heroes at objectives and keep dealing damage so it re-triggers through the fight.
plan.fight: Aim Dread slightly behind slowed targets so wave and eruption both hit, then dump Chaos autos; Waltz backward out of dives.
plan.late: Late, Dead Magic turns your autos into AoE burst; hold Waltz for their engage every time, cooldown greed is how you die.

probius.note: Zone control, protect the little guy
probius.why: below the games threshold entirely: niche zone mage

plan.early: Pylon in the bush, Warp Rift under the wave, pop it with Disruption Pulse; you win every clear war if pylons survive.
plan.mid: At 10 take Pylon Overcharge: pre-build pylons at the objective choke and force them to fight inside your cannon field.
plan.fight: Fight inside your power field: chain Warp Rifts in the choke, detonate with Pulse as they clump, retreat pylon to pylon.
plan.late: Late, Construct Additional Pylons makes objectives fortresses; caught without a field you are the slowest squishy alive.

probius.solo: Zone-control offlaner: pylons and rifts hold waves forever and deny trades, but dive bruisers demolish him one on one.

plan.early: Stutter-step autos to stack Give 'Em Some Pepper, Inspire on the wave to shove, and hold Penetrating Round purely to peel ganks.
plan.mid: Raynor's Raider at 10: drop the banshee on the objective tank and keep autoing from max range while Inspire keeps attack speed up.
plan.fight: Backline turret: sit max range, shoot their frontline until a diver commits, then knockback the diver and kite behind your tank.
plan.late: Line 'Em Up range at 13 lets you shred tanks from safety; you die instantly if dived, so never walk first and hug your team.

plan.early: Offlane: park a Mirror Image side-lane to double-soak, duel with Image Transmission swaps, Wind Walk out before the gank arrives.
plan.mid: Bladestorm at 10: spin when they clump on your team at the objective, or clear the point solo while your images hold tower aggro.
plan.fight: Enter on clones, Critical Strike the squishiest target, Image Transmission out the moment you are focused. Clean fights, never start them.
plan.late: Late you win by split-pushing side lanes and swapping out of every collapse; the risk is ARAM comps that never give you a map to use.

samuro.solo: Premier solo laner and camp thief: clones tank everything and almost nobody pins him; Stukov's silence and AoE cleave ruin the images.

sgthammer.note: Siege from another zip code, needs protection
sgthammer.why: 47.7% wr: immobile siege, feast or famine

plan.early: Siege behind your gate at max Artillery range, mine the flank bush, and unsiege the second their frontline steps toward you.
plan.mid: Blunt Force Gun at 10: fire it across the objective to finish runners or wipe the wave; stay sieged behind your team, never ahead.
plan.fight: Win by sieging where they can't reach: shell their frontline, keep Thrusters banked for the one dive, Spider Mines behind you.
plan.late: Advanced Artillery range shells keeps from outside tower range, that ends games; one Stitches hook or lockdown chain deletes you.

sylvanas.note: Trait shuts down structures, push machine
sylvanas.why: 54.1% wr + 27% ban on a big sample: deletes structures, wins every map

plan.early: Stack Black Arrows fast: shove with Withering Fire, poke structures with the trait stun, and keep Haunting Wave strictly as escape.
plan.mid: Mind Control at 10: on objectives drag their tank out of position, and your trait locks towers so your team dives gates for free.
plan.fight: Spread Black Arrows with autos from the second row, save Haunting Wave to dodge the engage; you shoot, you never frontline.
plan.late: Late you delete keeps in seconds: push a side lane to force a split, then Mind Control the flanker they send into your team.

tracer.why: 54.4% wr (thin sample): untouchable in good hands

plan.early: Roam between lanes finishing low targets, keep one Blink charge banked at all times, and Recall out of any trade gone wrong.
plan.mid: Level 10 upgrades your bomb: take Sticky Bomb, stick the healer on engage, and Blink clear before the pop; the slow strands them.
plan.fight: Weave onto the backline, dump full clips into the healer, Blink sideways through skillshots, Recall only when Blinks are spent.
plan.late: Late you win by never dying: drag chasers away from the fight, reload behind pillars, and let their respawn timers end the game.

tychus.why: 52.6% wr: best tank-shredder in the game

plan.early: Short range means patience: clear waves with Overkill, Run and Gun to dodge the gank angle, and trade only when Minigun is up.
plan.mid: Commandeer Odin at 10: stomp in as the objective starts; its range fixes your short arm and forces them to scatter or melt.
plan.fight: Shred the frontline: Minigun their tank for percent damage, Run and Gun out of dives, and hold Frag Grenade to peel for yourself.
plan.late: Late you beat every tank comp; the risk is your 4.5 range, so wait for their engage, then Odin second-line and burn the biggest target.

plan.early: Gank from Vanish: open Cheap Shot on overextended squishies, Sinister Strike out; you tax lanes with kill pressure, not soak.
plan.mid: Smoke Bomb at 10: open Garrote on the healer, drop Smoke when their peel arrives, and finish Eviscerate at 3 combo points inside.
plan.fight: Wait for their engage, then Garrote-silence the backline caster; you delete one target and Vanish out, you never stand and brawl.
plan.late: Late you own the fog: a pick before the objective wins the game, but breaking stealth to a stray AoE near their team is the throw.

valla.note: Safe hypercarry, Q build kites everything
valla.why: 49.5% wr on the biggest sample: reliable ranged damage

plan.early: Keep Hatred at 10 stacks by tagging something every 5 seconds, clear with Multishot, and treat Vault as your escape, not a toy.
plan.mid: Rain of Vengeance at 10: hold it to peel the diver off you or to chain stuns after your tank engages, never as opening poke.
plan.fight: Max-range autos on the closest safe target, Multishot to reveal stealth, and Vault away the instant a melee turns toward you.
plan.late: Manticore at 16 shreds tanks; late you win any autos-only fight but die to one gank, so never walk the map alone.

zagara.why: 48.5% wr: lane bully, falls off in fights

plan.early: Plant creep tumors every trip, shove with Banelings plus Infested Drop, and out-rotate: your speed and vision on creep win the map.
plan.mid: Devouring Maw at 10: swallow their healer plus a chaser on engage and kill the players left outside before it spits them back.
plan.fight: Sit max range on creep, Hunter Killer the squishiest target, Infested Drop on cooldown, and never get caught off creep by a diver.
plan.late: Late, shove side lanes before every fight and seed tumors deep; if they group your push wins, if they split Maw punishes the 4v5.

zagara.solo: Strong solo laner on big maps: trades with Hunter Killer, soaks safely behind creep vision, and is hard to gank on her own turf.

plan.early: Gank with Cleave burst from stealth, Blink in only when the exit is safe, and take camps between ganks; you don't sit in a lane.
plan.mid: Void Prison at 10: trap half their team on the objective and kill the outsiders, or Prison the rescuer to seal a pick.
plan.fight: Cleave plus autos on the healer, Blink to disjoint the return skillshot, Wormhole back out, re-stealth, and re-enter on cooldown.
plan.late: Late one good Prison wins the game: cut their frontline from backline at the choke; the risk is face-checking bushes into CC chains.

plan.early: Angle Twin Cleave through the wave onto their hero, channel Regeneration only from fog, and stack You Want Axe? without dying.
plan.mid: Taz'dingo at 10: flip it the moment their combo starts, then Berserker to max attack speed and stand in their face for 4 free seconds.
plan.fight: Ride low health on purpose for trait attack speed, shred the nearest tank, and Taz'dingo turns their all-in into your best fight.
plan.late: Amani Resilience at 20 makes Taz'dingo heal you back up; your real risk is being stunned before you press it, watch their CC first.

murky.note: Annoyance engine, trades time for value

plan.early: Hide the Egg deep in bushes, shove nonstop with Slime and Pufferfish, and trade your cheap deaths for their cooldowns and XP.
plan.mid: Octo-Grab at 10: waddle in and lock their healer or Hammer as your team dives, and call the target first so the stun isn't wasted.
plan.fight: Be the distraction: soak abilities up front, Safety Bubble through the burst, and Slime everything so your team cleans up the slowed mess.
plan.late: Late your death still only costs them time: keep the Egg moved, push the lane your team isn't in, and Grab the carry when they group.

murky.solo: Classic nuisance offlaner: rarely wins the 1v1 kill but never leaves, out-soaks through Egg respawns, and starves their bruiser.

plan.early: Offlane: keep Carnage bleeds rolling and pop Blood Rage to heal off the wave plus the laner. Grappling Hook over terrain for free ganks.
plan.mid: Final Strike at 10: bleed them down, Revolving Sweep to stick, then line the execute through both carries on the objective.
plan.fight: Revolving Sweep their carry to dodge damage while attached, drop the stun, spread bleeds, Blood Rage once three are marked.
plan.late: Late she snipes kills with Final Strike off any chip damage; knockback peel like E.T.C. blanks Sweep, engage after their CC is burned.

qhira.solo: Strong solo laner: bleeds plus Blood Rage outsustain most bruisers and Hook makes her ungankable; hard CC ganks and Yrel beat her.

lostvikings.note: Triple soak wins XP, needs macro brain
lostvikings.why: 53.9% wr on 104 games: macro gods in expert hands, useless otherwise

plan.early: Three lanes, three Vikings: Olaf takes the dangerous lane, Erik roams the edges, Baleog clears; soak every wave, hit talent spikes first.
plan.mid: Play Again at 10 on big maps: keep soaking until the objective goes live, then summon all three in fresh; Erik stalls channels.
plan.fight: Never clump: Olaf body-blocks and charges to peel, Baleog spins the wave, Erik kites wide; losing one Viking is fine, three is a wipe.
plan.late: The XP lead is the win condition: you reach 20 first, so force fights at your spike and never let a Viking die shown on the map.

lostvikings.solo: Not one solo laner but three: they win the soak war outright, and collapsing on one Viking still leaves two earning elsewhere.

arthas.why: 49.4% wr: melee-killer aura, slows win brawls

plan.early: Trade with Death Coil, root predictable paths with Howling Blast, toggle Frozen Tempest only in trades; it drains mana fast
plan.mid: Sindragosa at 10: hit 3+ heroes or freeze the fort before you push; disabled towers make your objective follow-up free
plan.fight: Walk through their front to the AA carry, Tempest halves attack speed, Howling Blast the dash as it starts. Enter last, no escape
plan.late: Frostmourne Hungers plus Remorseless Winter at 16 melts anyone in melee; displacement is death, so hug your team and walls

arthas.solo: Strong solo vs melee: Frozen Tempest ruins AA bruisers; ranged offlaners kite him for free and Ana cuts his self-heal

hogger.why: 54.2% wr, unanimous S in every source: rage sustain + wall slams

plan.early: Throw Loot Hoard for the meat heal, Staggering Blow enemies into it or walls for stuns, keep Rage above 50 by trading often
plan.mid: Hoardapult at 10: launch onto their backline at objectives, Hogg Wild spin the clump, Staggering Blow stragglers into terrain
plan.fight: Pin their carry to a wall with Staggering Blow, point-blank Ez-Thro Dynamite so it pops instantly, spin out with Hogg Wild
plan.late: No wall means no stun: pick fight locations first. Stay above 50 Rage for the armor or you fall over in seconds

hogger.solo: Premier offlaner: wins most melee matchups with wall stuns and meat sustain; poke ranged like Lunara starve him out

maiev.note: Cage the fight, umbral bind cleave
maiev.why: 46.9% wr this patch (volatile): cage plays still win fights

plan.early: Fan of Knives resets clear waves instantly; rotate and set ganks with Umbral Bind from bushes. Hold Vault to escape, never to engage.
plan.mid: Containment Disc at 10: disc the healer or a Cho'gall at objective start, then Umbral Bind the rest back into your team's AoE.
plan.fight: Spirit of Vengeance in, Umbral Bind two or more, drag them back into your team. Hold Fan of Knives until it hits at least two heroes.
plan.late: Late she chain-fights off Fan resets and the Disc pick decides fights. Unstoppable and cleanse blank the Bind, track those cooldowns.

maiev.solo: Not a real solo laner: no sustain and her value is roam ganks; if forced, clear fast with Fan and rotate rather than trade.

mei.why: 47.9% wr: stall kit, low kill pressure

plan.early: Offlane on blind uptime: Snow Blind every trade so melee whiff, Icing out of ganks, Cryo-Freeze baits their full combo for free.
plan.mid: Ice Wall at 10: cut their frontline off from the healer on the objective, or wall the choke so they enter the fight in halves.
plan.fight: Peel machine: blind the enemy auto-attacker on cooldown, Blizzard the clump for the stun, Cryo-Freeze the burst aimed at you.
plan.late: Late one good Ice Wall wins the fight before it starts; the risk is walling YOUR team wrong. Breathe, cut their backline, not yours.

mei.solo: Great solo lane vs auto-attack melee: Snow Blind makes Butcher and Illidan whiff; loses to poke like Hanzo who never touches her blind.
